title: Psychology Facts
hook: Three doors. One prize. Should you switch?
facts: You pick one door. The host opens a losing one.
He always knew where the *prize* was.
In *1990*, Marilyn vos Savant explained the puzzle in her column.
Now you can stay, or *switch*. Which is smarter?
Most people stay, because staying feels *safer*.
Switching wins *two out of three* times.
outro: Stay, or switch? Now you know.
